set.body:
PURPOSE

Implement the first honest feature-analysis vertical slice only after storymodel4s supplies a durable, receipted feature result. Replace synthetic raw-value mockup evidence with provider-owned data and provenance.

PROVIDER ENTRY CONTRACT

The input must carry token-addressed values or ordinals, window/support definitions, reducer and normalization identity, coverage and missingness, alternatives or uncertainty where applicable, and a use/provenance ledger. StoryAtlas must not compute or silently impute these quantities.

ACCEPTANCE

- The same provider result is shown in the Codex text rail and a feature scale-space view without copying or reinterpreting values.
- Token/address identity, windows, aggregation support, normalization, missingness, coverage, and provenance remain inspectable.
- Linked focus and selection resolve through Address/NavigationIndex, never renderer names or pixel coordinates.
- A missing/partial/malformed feature result fails closed or renders a provider-defined unavailable state; it never becomes zero.
- Static preview, textual twin, interactive app, mutation tests, deterministic receipts, keyboard paths, non-colour semantics, and 200 percent zoom courts pass.
- The plate contains no synthetic-data claim once marked as real; fixtures remain clearly labelled where still synthetic.
set.title: Render one real receipted feature through Codex and feature scale-space
